FX-KIRA-001.says: The settings as they start: threshold 95, spacing 64, density 60, size 40, a star, angle 0, twinkle 100, period 24, seed 0, opacity 100, white. The frame is one cell, and it is chosen, so its three white glints, the point, the square and the soft one, share one star at their middle, (8.5, 4.17), on the clear; the grey, 60 %, is no highlight, nor is the gold, bright but coloured. At frame 0 the star is early in its twinkle and small; four frames later it is larger and brighter.

FX-KIRA-002.says: Opacity 0: the drawing, untouched, and nothing grows.

FX-KIRA-003.says: Size 0: the drawing, untouched, and nothing grows.

FX-KIRA-004.says: Density 0: no cell is chosen; the drawing, untouched, and nothing grows.

FX-KIRA-005.says: Threshold 100: nothing is that bright, so there is no star and the drawing is untouched.

FX-KIRA-006.says: Spacing 8, size 6, density 100, twinkle 0, a cross: three steady stars, one in each cell with a highlight, a plus of four arms fading to nothing, with a small round core: on the white point, (2.5, 4.5), landing on whole pixels; on the square's middle, (11, 3), a pixel corner, so its arms are shared between the pixels either side; and on the soft glint, (4.5, 8.5), as strong as the others. The grey and the gold have none; pixels off the arms stay as they were.

FX-KIRA-007.says: FX-KIRA-006 as a star: each also has four short arms on the diagonals, half as long, so the pixels diagonally next to the white point light too.

FX-KIRA-008.says: FX-KIRA-006 at angle 45: each plus turned into an X; the pixels straight beside the white point, lit in FX-KIRA-006, now keep only the core's light.

FX-KIRA-009.says: Angle 90: a quarter turn of a plus is the same plus, so it is FX-KIRA-006.

FX-KIRA-010.says: FX-KIRA-006 at threshold 60: the grey, at exactly 60 %, is a highlight too, and has its own star at (13.5, 8.5); the gold, its smallest channel 47 %, is still none.

FX-KIRA-011.says: FX-KIRA-006 at spacing 16: the frame is one cell, so the three glints share one star at their middle, (8.5, 4.17).

FX-KIRA-012.says: FX-KIRA-006 at density 60: the square's cell is not chosen at seed 0, so the square has no star; the other two are FX-KIRA-006's exactly.

FX-KIRA-013.says: FX-KIRA-006 at seed 7: the stars stay on the glints, each a different size.

FX-KIRA-014.says: FX-KIRA-006 twinkling fully, twinkle 100, period 4: each star grows and fades on its own beat, frame 1 and frame 2 different from frame 0, and frame 4, a whole period on, frame 0 again.

FX-KIRA-015.says: Twinkle 50, period 4: each star breathes between half and full, and never goes out.

FX-KIRA-016.says: Colour #ff8000, orange: FX-KIRA-006's stars tinted, their red as before, their green a fifth and their blue gone; the covering as FX-KIRA-006's.

FX-KIRA-017.says: FX-KIRA-016 with its colour written in capitals, #FF8000: the same.

FX-KIRA-018.says: Opacity 50: FX-KIRA-006's light at half strength.

FX-KIRA-019.says: Size keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 12 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 2 is FX-KIRA-006, frame 4 is size 12.

FX-KIRA-020.says: Opacity eased from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it would pass 100, is held at 100, and is FX-KIRA-006, as frame 4 is.

FX-KIRA-021.says: FX-KIRA-006 moved three pixels right: the stars move with the drawing, and the white point's left arm, which runs past the drawing's left edge, shows in the grown column just left of it; the two columns further left stay empty.

FX-KIRA-022.says: Threshold 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KIRA-023.says: Spacing 1, below 2. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KIRA-024.says: Size 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KIRA-025.says: Period 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KIRA-026.says: Twinkle keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KIRA-027.says: A shape written "circle", not cross or star. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KIRA-028.says: A colour written "#12345", one digit short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KIRA-029.says: Seed 100001, above 100000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
